ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Moon and Venus at {H:1812018185000}

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1812055397000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The Moon and Venus are together in {S:1}: emotion and intuition, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.
